chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated that he said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated from Ali ibn Hassan al-Wasiti, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir al-Hashimi, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) say:

Gabriel descended upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said: O Muhammad, indeed Allah, Glorified be His Glory, sends you peace and says: Indeed, I have forbidden the Fire for the loins from which you descended, the womb that carried you, and the lap that nurtured you. He said: O Gabriel, clarify that to me. He said: As for the loins from which you descended, it is Abdullah ibn Abd al-Muttalib, and as for the womb that carried you, it is Amina bint Wahb, and as for the lap that nurtured you, it is Abu Talib ibn Abd al-Muttalib and Fatima bint Asad.

key_terms.آمنةُ بِنْتُ وَهْبٍ: Amina bint Wahb, the mother of the Prophet
key_terms.أَبُو طَالِبٍ: Abu Talib, the uncle of the Prophet who protected him
key_terms.بَطْنٍ: Womb or belly, referring to the maternal line
key_terms.جِبْرِئِيلُ: Gabriel, the archangel who delivers divine messages
key_terms.حَجَرٍ: Lap or home, referring to the nurturing and guardianship
key_terms.صَلْبٍ: Loins or lineage, referring to the paternal line
key_terms.فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ أَسَدٍ: Fatima bint Asad, the aunt of the Prophet and mother of Imam Ali

ai.seo_question: Who are the specific relatives of the Prophet Muhammad that are forbidden from the Hellfire according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar* elucidates the specific familial lineage protected from Hellfire, identifying Abdullah (loins), Amina (womb), and Abu Talib and Fatima bint Asad (nurturing home). In Shia scholarship, this is often interpreted as a unique honor (*Istiqra'*) for these four figures due to their direct role in the Prophet’s physical existence and upbringing, distinct from the general intercession or faith-based salvation of other believers. The narration underscores the sanctity of the Prophet’s immediate kinship network in preserving the divine message.
